product.name: AGROVERCITY — Kisan Setu
product.tagline: Aapki Zameen, Aapka Business Aapka Control

designSystem.accessibility: 48x48dp tap targets, WCAG 2.1 AA, high-contrast mode, sunlight-optimized

product.source: flutter-prototype (package kisan_setu_app); all data is demo/mock, no backend yet

onboarding.name: Two-phase splash
features: Phase 1: parent company logo pop-up (tap to skip)
Phase 2: brand reveal with gradient title + Get Started CTA

onboarding.name: Language selection
features: GPS region suggestion (reverse-geocode -> top-2 regional languages)

onboarding.name: Multi-profile selection
features: Multi-select with one starred primary profile

onboarding.name: Login / Register
features: Register wizard: (1) name/state/mobile+OTP with 30s resend, (2) set MPIN twice, (3) farm details: village/tehsil, land slider 0.5-25 acres, soil chips, irrigation chips, crop multi-select + custom crops
Region-wise crop suggestions by district (planned: ICRISAT/State data)

modules.name: Farmer Home Dashboard
modules.purpose: Central hub for the farmer persona
features: Hero header (name/village/land, LIVE APMC beacon, chat + notifications, active-role capsule, voice search)
Weather strip with rain radar badge
Our Services grid (transport, market price, Kisan Mitra chat, agri loan)
Special Modules grid (insurance, plantation, live channels, livestock, diary, news, gyan hub)
Aaj ke Bhav live vyapari-rate widget (waveform, up/down change, offline cache notice)

modules.name: Mandi Prices & Profit Maximizer
modules.purpose: Live APMC prices and best-mandi net-profit comparison
features: Mandi cards (modal/min/max price, MSP, arrivals, trend, distance, updated time)
Smart Mandi Selection calculator (quantity slider, net profit after transport)

modules.name: AI Crop Advisory & Market Risk
modules.purpose: AI-driven crop, disease, and market-risk guidance
features: Market saturation tab (sowing intent -> 5-20km sowing count, arrival spike, 3-month risk meter, alternative crops)
Leaf disease scan (camera, confidence %, chemical + organic treatment)

modules.name: Agri Input Marketplace
modules.purpose: E-commerce for seeds, fertilizer, pesticide, tools, vehicles
features: Product cards (brand, dealer, batch no, rating, MRP/discount, delivery time, BNPL)

modules.name: Buyer Contracts & Vehicle Booking
modules.purpose: Pre-sowing price-lock contracts and agri transport
features: Contract cards (locked rate, premium above MSP, min quantity, payment terms)
Vehicle booking (type dropdown, distance slider, live fare estimate)

modules.name: Farm CEO — Profit & Loss
modules.purpose: Per-crop P&L and break-even planning
features: 3 KPI cards (gross income, cost, net profit)

modules.name: Water Intelligence
modules.purpose: Irrigation scheduling and water resources

modules.name: Government Scheme Intelligence
modules.purpose: Scheme discovery, eligibility, and application
features: Encrypted document vault (Aadhaar, 7/12, passbook, soil health card, AES-256)
Dual apply: in-app or official portal deep-link (Custom Tabs, security banner, no Aadhaar caching)

modules.name: Embedded Finance
modules.purpose: Credit score, loans, Kisan Credit Card
features: Kisan credit score card (score, tier, limit, RBI note)
Instant input-loan calculator (amount/tenure sliders, live EMI, 7%)

modules.name: Crop Insurance (PMFBY/RWBCIS)
modules.purpose: Policy management, claims, premium calculation
features: Policies tab: digital passbook, e-certificate PDF, quick-apply, PMFBY portal
72h claim intimation (calamity, crop stage, loss %, geo-tagged photos, auto claim number)
Premium calculator (season, crop, acreage -> sum insured, farmer share, govt subsidy, cutoff)
Claim tracker (intimation -> surveyor -> assessment -> DBT approval -> payout)

modules.name: Land & Legal — 7/12 Records
modules.purpose: Maharashtra land record search and import
features: Search by Gat number or village (fuzzy)
Record cards (owner, khata/ferfar, area, soil, irrigation, crop history)
Planned: mahabhulekh/Aaple Sarkar APIs, other states

modules.name: FPO Growth Engine
modules.purpose: Farmer Producer Org collective buying and shared machinery
features: Bulk procurement pool (group buy progress, discount, join with units)

modules.name: Mahila Kisan Hub
modules.purpose: Women farmer empowerment (also global women-mode theme)
features: SHG savings group (corpus, loan fund, monthly deposit)

modules.name: Climate-Smart Farming & Carbon Credits
modules.purpose: Carbon income potential and resilient varieties
features: Carbon income hero card (Rs/yr, CO2e MT via biochar/zero-till/green manure)

modules.name: Post-Harvest Supply Chain
modules.purpose: Cold storage and AI quality grading
features: Cold storage cards (distance, temp range, capacity MT, rate/q/month)
AI quality grading (AGMARK grade, uniformity, shelf life, recommended price)

modules.name: Krishi Ratna Gamification
modules.purpose: Levels, AgriCoins, rewards store
features: Level banner (level, title, coins, streak, XP)
Rewards store (vouchers, soil test, scientist video call) with coin redemption

modules.name: Refer & Earn
modules.purpose: Referral program

modules.name: Farm Diary
modules.purpose: Daily income/expense/activity log
features: Add entry (type, category, amount, crop, notes) +15 coins

modules.name: Agri News
modules.purpose: News feed with audio
features: News cards (impact rating, source, audio readout)

modules.name: Live Channels
modules.purpose: Live agri TV, auctions, expert streams
features: Channel list (DD Kisan, KVK, mandi auctions)

modules.name: Livestock & Dairy Ecosystem
modules.purpose: Gaushala, nursery, vet, dairy marketplace
features: Vet tab (24x7 helpline, doctor cards, farm-visit/clinic booking)
Dairy products tab (A2 ghee/milk/paneer, purity cert, direct buy)

modules.name: Gyan Hub — Knowledge
modules.purpose: Workshops, expert talks, videos, blogs
features: Paid workshops (ICAR-certified, seats, fee with coin discount, enroll)

modules.name: Tree Plantation & Biofuel
modules.purpose: Tree economy: articles, NGOs, biofuel, care
features: NGO tab (ratings, free saplings, request dialog)
Biofuel trees (oil %, return/acre, gestation, subsidy, buyers)

modules.name: Equipment Rental — Yantra Time-Slots
modules.purpose: Slot-based machinery booking
features: Slot status (available/booked/pending), per-slot pricing, recommended task
Rules: max 2 slots/farmer/day, cancel up to 2h before (SMS), FPO auto-confirm vs private manual, 30min reminders, waitlist

aiAssistant.name: Kisan Mitra
surfaces: Floating FAB on every screen (pulse + halo + online beacon)
Voice sheet (Bhashini AI branding, mic orb, transcript, quick prompts)
Chatbot sheet (bubbles, voice input, quick replies, rich cards, expert handoff)
capabilities: Rich cards (market saturation, weather, mandi, pest)
Human expert handoff (sends chat + farm data to agronomist)

plannedBackend.llm: OpenRouter API with fine-tuned agri prompts

crossCutting.offline: Offline/sync pill + queue counter; cached rates with timestamps; backend must support idempotent queued writes (diary, claims, bookings)
crossCutting.audio: TTS readout buttons across screens; news items carry audioText scripts
crossCutting.video: video_player dependency present; placeholder URLs; plan HLS for live channels
crossCutting.navigation: State-machine router (AppState.currentRoute), luxury top bar, floating dock -> All Tools sheet (role-filtered), back-stack history, radial orbit menu (alternative, unwired)
crossCutting.womenMode: Global rose theme overlay (#BE123C), not a profile type

changeRequests: CR1: Mukta font migration (15+ languages, Android 6+/2GB testing)
CR2: Two-step splash (group logo -> brand, 4.5s, offline logos)
CR3: Light theme migration (#F5F7FA/#43A047 palette, WCAG AA)
CR4: Region-wise language selection (GPS reverse-geocode, audio preview)
CR5: Region-wise crop suggestions (district mapping, seasonal smart defaults)
CR6: Govt scheme deep-linking (Custom Tabs, portal mapping, vault attach, security)
CR7: Live vyapari rate widget (2h refresh 6AM-8PM, Agmarknet/eNAM fallback, offline cache)
CR8: Kisan Mitra chatbot (OpenRouter, Sarvam STT, expert handoff, offline queue)
CR9: Market saturation advisory (privacy-preserving counts, risk meter, alternatives)
CR10: Time-slot yantra booking (4x4h slots, max 2/day, waitlist, SMS rules)
CR11: 7/12 search by Gat/village (mahabhulekh/Aaple Sarkar, PDF, auto-import)
phases: P2: backend profile sync, rich dashboards, unlinking, persona notifications
P3 monetization: seller analytics, broker CRM, transporter fleet mgmt, commission payments
P4 intelligence: role-based AI advisory, demand forecasting, cross-persona recommendations
